## The Problem
Project management tools force a trade-off: either your data lives in a proprietary cloud service, or you manage plain files without the views (Gantt, Kanban, table) that make project tracking practical. MacOS database clients force a trade-off: single-engine open source tools (Sequel Ace, Postico) or polished multi-database tools that are either proprietary (TablePlus) or non-native (DBeaver, Beekeeper Studio). TablePro targets the missing quadrant — native, multi-database, and open source — with a Swift codebase (4,250 Swift files) and a plugin architecture for database drivers.

entry.title: all agentic architectures
entry.summary:
## The Problem
Modern agentic systems often struggle with the reliability of LLM-as-scorer mechanisms, where probabilistic free-text outputs lead to inconsistent agent behavior—colloquially known as the "flat-band pathology." This repository addresses that instability by implementing a deterministic-picker pattern, requiring LLMs to commit to categorical features (booleans, enums) rather than unstructured scores, allowing Python to compose the final decision signal.
